obsiread.description:
ObsiRead turns any web page into a clean, quiet page to read.
Share a link from your browser. ObsiRead keeps only the article: the text, headings and pictures. Ads, pop-ups and clutter are gone. It uses the same page reader as Obsidian Web Clipper.
• Read without distraction. The bars hide while you read. Tap the page to bring them back.
• Highlight anything. Hold and drag, then add a note or a tag.
• Save to Obsidian in one tap. It uses your own templates and your own vault. Each highlight links back to its sentence on the web.
• Jump to any heading from the contents list.
• Make it yours with ten themes, five fonts, and controls for size, spacing and margins.
• Read every comment. Forums and comment threads load in full, and each reply sits under the one it answers.
• Links open in a card over the article. Save the page if you like it.
